newsitem.title: INDIA: India bullion trade on holiday for Hindu New Year.
newsitem.headline: India bullion trade on holiday for Hindu New Year.

text.p: India's gold and silver markets are shut on Monday and Tuesday for the Hindu New Year, dealers said on Tuesday. The markets reopen on Wednesday.
On Friday, gold and silver prices opened higher on the back of a global recovery but fell towards the close amid demand resistance, dealers said.
Higher prices in the local market attracted profit-taking by stockists and importers later in the day while sentiment turned subdued at the close despite the weekend's Diwali festival.
Bullion prices are expected to remain weak in the next week after conclusion of Diwali festival.
